cells.gaps: In November 2026 the Health Minister named DHIMS as the public health information system (GHA-004), but no source found says facilities or districts across the country report through it, nor through LHIMS or GHIMS (GHA-001, GHA-002).
cells.note: Held at 2: GHA-004 names DHIMS as the public health system in service but does not say who reports through it, and question 2 needs facilities or districts across the country reporting. LHIMS deployment (GHA-002) and its GHIMS replacement (GHA-001) are hospital systems under way.
